detail.title: China's Copper Supply Capacity and Pathway Structure under Carbon Constraints: A Dynamic MFA-Linear Optimization Coupling Framework
detail.abstract: China’s carbon-neutrality target places its copper supply system under joint carbon-budget and cost pressures. We develop a copper budget model that couples dynamic material flow analysis with intertemporal linear optimization, endogenously allocating 11 domestic and import-based pathways from resources to final product under a tightening sectoral carbon budget (2024–2060). Results show the budget markedly constrains domestic primary supply, and the future mix is governed by competition along a moving carbon–cost frontier. Circular-economy levers (lifetime extension and higher recovery) stabilize in-use stocks, while low-carbon process options, especially hydrogen-enabled smelting, ease the carbon bottleneck; combining both performs best. Policy sensitivity indicates subsidies for hydrogen-based primary smelting raise total supply with limited carbon-intensity penalties, whereas subsidizing domestic mining can reduce system-wide carbon efficiency. Robust portfolios should prioritize demand-side efficiency, recycling infrastructure, and targeted support for high-leverage low-carbon segments.

AI.tldr: 中国碳中和目标使铜供应系统面临碳预算和成本双重压力。研究开发了耦合动态物质流分析与跨期线性优化的铜预算模型，在收紧的部门碳预算下（2024-2060）内生分配11条国内和进口供应路径。结果显示碳预算显著限制国内初级供应，未来供应结构由移动的碳-成本前沿竞争决定。循环经济杠杆（延长寿命、提高回收率）稳定在用存量，低碳工艺（特别是氢冶炼）缓解碳瓶颈，两者结合效果最佳。政策敏感性分析表明氢冶炼补贴可提高总供应量且碳强度惩罚有限，而补贴国内采矿可能降低系统碳效率。
AI.research_question: 在碳中和目标下，中国铜供应系统如何在碳预算约束下实现最优的供应路径配置？
AI.motivation: 中国碳中和目标使铜供应系统面临碳预算和成本双重压力，需要研究如何在碳约束下优化铜供应路径，平衡成本与碳排放。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态物质流分析、跨期线性优化、碳-成本前沿理论、循环经济理论
AI.method: 开发铜预算模型，耦合动态物质流分析与跨期线性优化，内生分配11条国内和进口供应路径，在2024-2060年部门碳预算约束下进行优化分析。
AI.findings: 1. 碳预算显著限制国内初级铜供应；2. 未来供应结构由移动的碳-成本前沿竞争决定；3. 循环经济杠杆（延长寿命、提高回收率）稳定在用存量；4. 低碳工艺（特别是氢冶炼）缓解碳瓶颈；5. 两者结合效果最佳；6. 氢冶炼补贴可提高总供应量且碳强度惩罚有限；7. 补贴国内采矿可能降低系统碳效率。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 开发了耦合动态物质流分析与跨期线性优化的铜预算模型；2. 提出了碳-成本前沿竞争框架；3. 量化分析了循环经济与低碳技术的协同效应；4. 为碳约束下的资源供应优化提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供碳约束下铜供应优化路径；2. 识别氢冶炼等关键低碳技术的重要性；3. 建议优先发展需求侧效率、回收基础设施和有针对性的低碳技术支持；4. 避免补贴国内采矿等可能降低系统碳效率的政策。

title: Migration Inflow and School Performance of Incumbent Students
affiliations: , University of Erlangen-Nuremberg-Friedrich Alexander Universität Erlangen Nürnberg and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Migration Inflow and School Performance of Incumbent Students
detail.abstract: We examine how exposure to recent migrants affects the academic performance of Swedish students, exploiting the variation in exposure between grades within schools, and between siblings, during a period of increasing refugee migration. Once we account for the sorting of migrants and less academically successful incumbent children into more exposed schools, and also account for within-family school choices, we find a small positive effect on test scores driven by schools outside large cities. Class size reductions are found to play a role in the positive effects. The results are corroborated by an events study of the acute refugee exposure of the 2015-2016 migration crisis.

AI.tldr: 研究瑞典学生接触近期移民对其学业成绩的影响，发现大城市以外的学校有轻微积极影响，班级规模缩小在其中起重要作用。
AI.research_question: 接触近期移民如何影响瑞典学生的学业成绩？
AI.motivation: 随着难民移民增加，了解移民对学生学业成绩的影响对教育政策制定至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 利用学校内年级间和兄弟姐妹间的接触差异，控制移民和学业较差学生的选择性分布，以及家庭内学校选择的影响。
AI.method: 利用学校内年级间接触差异和兄弟姐妹间差异，控制选择性分布；通过2015-2016年移民危机的准自然实验进行事件研究验证。
AI.findings: 在控制选择性分布后，发现对考试成绩有轻微积极影响，主要来自大城市以外的学校；班级规模缩小在其中起重要作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了移民接触对学生学业成绩影响的因果证据，揭示了班级规模机制的作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为教育政策制定者提供实证依据，表明适当管理移民接触可能对本地学生学业有积极影响。

title: Identifying and Prioritising Multilevel Barriers to Occupational Health and Well-being in Ghana’s Construction Industry
affiliations: Kumasi Polytechnic and Kumasi Polytechnic

detail.title: Identifying and Prioritising Multilevel Barriers to Occupational Health and Well-being in Ghana’s Construction Industry
detail.abstract: Purpose The proposed research aims to define, classify and prioritise the multilevel chronic obstacles that hinder promotion of occupational health and well-being in the construction industry in Ghana. Study design/methodology/approach Purposively, a cross-sectional quantitative survey using validated five-point Likert surveys was distributed to the engineers, project managers, labourers and administrators within the various Ghanaian construction companies. Analysis of multiple regression was used to assess the relative impact of ten postulated impediments. Findings Supervisory adherence to a safety and protection norm was the overriding element of OHW outcomes. The process of technological embracement, performance measures, communication gaps, employee participation, financial limitations, and weaknesses in regulatory supervision had enormous impacts. Additionally, stakeholder coordination and informal labour practices were contextually apposite. The integrated model strongly forecasted the occupational health condition at the construction workplaces. Conclusion Improving OHW requires parallel efforts to enhance enforceable safety legislation, foster responsible leadership, utilise advanced information technologies for monitoring, engage workers effectively, secure funding sources, and strengthen the capacity of regulatory organisations to enforce. It is also suggested to introduce centralised systems of communication and all-inclusive safety committees to overcome any gaps caused by the project organisation's separation and informality of labour. Originality/value The research was the first to provide a Ghana-focused empirically verified structure in categorising the OHW barriers, supplying construction companies, regulators and development agencies with focused and evidence-based objectives of sustainable health interventions.

AI.tldr: 本研究旨在识别、分类和优先排序阻碍加纳建筑业职业健康与福祉（OHW）的多层次慢性障碍。研究发现，监管层对安全规范的遵守是影响OHW的最关键因素，同时技术采纳、绩效衡量、沟通差距、员工参与、资金限制和监管薄弱等因素也有显著影响。研究提出了一个综合模型来预测建筑工地的职业健康状况。
AI.research_question: 阻碍加纳建筑业职业健康与福祉（OHW）推广的多层次慢性障碍是什么？如何对这些障碍进行分类和优先排序？
AI.motivation: 加纳建筑业的职业健康与福祉面临多重挑战，但缺乏系统性的障碍识别和分类框架。本研究旨在填补这一空白，为制定有针对性的干预措施提供实证基础。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于多层次障碍理论框架，从监管、组织、技术、财务、沟通和劳动力实践等多个维度分析职业健康与福祉的障碍因素。
AI.method: 采用横断面定量调查设计，使用经过验证的五点李克特量表问卷，向加纳建筑公司的工程师、项目经理、工人和管理人员发放。采用多元回归分析评估十个假设障碍的相对影响。
AI.findings: 监管层对安全规范的遵守是影响OHW的最关键因素。技术采纳过程、绩效衡量、沟通差距、员工参与、资金限制和监管薄弱也有显著影响。利益相关者协调和非正式劳动力实践在特定情境下相关。综合模型能够有效预测建筑工地的职业健康状况。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次为加纳建筑业提供了经过实证验证的职业健康与福祉障碍分类框架，扩展了多层次障碍理论在发展中国家建筑业的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为建筑公司、监管机构和开发机构提供了基于证据的干预目标，包括：加强可执行的安全立法、培养负责任领导力、利用先进信息技术进行监控、有效员工参与、确保资金来源、加强监管机构执法能力，以及建立集中沟通系统和包容性安全委员会。

title: Anchoring and Interactivity in the Digital Age: How Online Interfaces Reshape Credit Card Repayment Decisions
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, Universidad del Desarrollo and University of Chile

detail.title: Anchoring and Interactivity in the Digital Age: How Online Interfaces Reshape Credit Card Repayment Decisions
detail.abstract: Suboptimal credit card repayment decisions are often driven by anchoring on low minimum payments. As financial services move to interactive digital platforms, the effects of this new choice architecture are largely unknown. This study investigates how interface design—specifically, anchor salience and interactivity—influences repayment choices. In a pre-registered online experiment, 2,503 U.S. credit cardholders were randomly assigned to one of five repayment interfaces. We find that simplicity is most effective at increasing payments: a static interface highlighting the full statement balance increased the proportion of the balance paid by 7.45 percentage points while simultaneously reducing decision times, suggesting it lowered cognitive load. In contrast, the effect of interactive sliders was contingent on their default setting. A slider anchored to a low payment significantly decreased full repayments, while one anchored high yielded repayments statistically indistinguishable from the control. Furthermore, interactive sliders increased decision time, indicating a greater cognitive effort in the decision. These findings provide causal evidence that in digital financial environments, simple, high-anchor static interfaces are more effective and cognitively less demanding than interactive tools, whose impact is dependent on their default settings.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，在数字信用卡还款界面中，简单静态的高锚点设计（突出显示全额还款）比交互式滑块更有效，能提高还款比例并降低认知负荷，而交互式滑块的效果取决于默认设置。
AI.research_question: 数字信用卡还款界面的设计（锚点显著性和交互性）如何影响用户的还款决策？
AI.motivation: 信用卡还款决策常受最低还款额锚定效应影响，随着金融服务向数字平台转移，这种新选择架构的影响尚不清楚，需要研究界面设计如何影响还款行为。
AI.theoretical_framework: 锚定效应理论、选择架构理论、认知负荷理论
AI.method: 预注册在线实验，2,503名美国信用卡持卡人被随机分配到五种还款界面之一，测量还款比例和决策时间
AI.findings: 1. 简单静态界面（突出显示全额还款）使还款比例提高7.45个百分点，同时减少决策时间，表明降低认知负荷；2. 交互式滑块的效果取决于默认设置：低锚点滑块显著减少全额还款，高锚点滑块与对照组无统计差异；3. 交互式滑块增加决策时间，表明需要更大认知努力
AI.theory_contributions: 为数字金融环境中锚定效应和选择架构理论提供因果证据，揭示界面设计特征（静态vs交互、锚点显著性）对决策质量和认知负荷的影响机制
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融机构设计数字还款界面提供具体指导：优先采用简单静态的高锚点设计，避免使用低锚点交互式滑块，以促进更好的还款行为并降低用户认知负担

title: Firm-Level Uncertainty and Institutional Context: Strategic Responses to Cash-Flow Volatility in Biotechnology
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Firm-Level Uncertainty and Institutional Context: Strategic Responses to Cash-Flow Volatility in Biotechnology
detail.abstract: This study examines how firm-level cash-flow volatility shapes strategic and financial responses in the biotechnology industry and how these effects are conditioned by national institutional quality. Drawing on a panel of publicly listed biotechnology firms from multiple countries, we analyse firms’ R&D intensity, financial leverage, and cash holdings using fixed-effects models with firm and country–year controls. We find that greater cash-flow volatility is associated with higher R&D intensity and more conservative financial structures, particularly lower leverage. Institutional quality moderates these relationships unevenly: stronger institutions attenuate firms’ reliance on internal cash buffers but do not uniformly stabilise strategic investment behaviour. Robustness tests using alternative volatility windows and institutional measures confirm the persistence of the main effects. The findings highlight the importance of integrating firm-level uncertainty with institutional context when analysing strategic decision-making in innovation-intensive industries and contribute to international business research on institutions, uncertainty, and corporate finance.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨生物技术行业中企业层面现金流波动如何影响战略和财务决策，以及国家制度质量如何调节这些关系。研究发现现金流波动越大，企业研发强度越高，财务结构越保守（杠杆率越低）。制度质量能减弱企业对内部现金缓冲的依赖，但不会稳定战略投资行为。
AI.research_question: 企业层面的现金流波动如何影响生物技术企业的战略和财务决策？国家制度质量如何调节这些关系？
AI.motivation: 生物技术行业具有高度创新性和不确定性，企业面临现金流波动挑战。现有研究较少同时考虑企业层面不确定性和国家制度背景对战略决策的影响，特别是在创新密集型产业中。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合企业财务理论（现金流波动、财务保守主义）与制度理论（国家制度质量作为调节变量），探讨在创新密集型产业中不确定性与战略决策的关系。
AI.method: 使用多国上市生物技术企业的面板数据，采用固定效应模型分析研发强度、财务杠杆和现金持有，控制企业和国家-年份因素。稳健性检验包括不同波动窗口和制度测量方法。
AI.findings: 1. 现金流波动越大，研发强度越高，财务结构越保守（杠杆率越低）；2. 制度质量调节作用不均衡：强制度减弱企业对内部现金缓冲的依赖，但不会稳定战略投资行为；3. 主要效应在不同测量方法下保持稳健。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将企业层面不确定性与制度背景整合，丰富国际商务研究中制度、不确定性和公司财务的交叉领域；2. 揭示制度质量对战略和财务决策的不同调节作用；3. 为创新密集型产业的战略决策提供理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 帮助生物技术企业管理者在现金流波动时制定更有效的研发和财务策略；2. 为政策制定者提供改善制度环境以支持创新企业的依据；3. 为投资者评估创新企业的风险和战略提供参考。

title: Measuring Systemic Risk Beyond Market Signals Realised Credit Losses and Basel III Capital Calibration
affiliations: Monash University and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Measuring Systemic Risk Beyond Market Signals Realised Credit Losses and Basel III Capital Calibration
detail.abstract: This paper examines systemic risk in the Australian banking sector using realised credit losses rather than market-implied proxies. Utilising Basel III Pillar 3 disclosures for the four Australian domestic systemically important banks (D-SIBs) over 2008–2024, we model marginal loss distributions using heavy-tailed specifications and capture interbank dependence through copula-based structures. Model selection favours an upper-tail-dependent Survival Clayton copula over symmetric Gaussian alternatives, indicating that joint credit losses cluster disproportionately during stress periods. Simulations suggest that correlation-based frameworks may materially understate system-wide tail risk, with Expected Shortfall potentially underestimated by approximately 24% under the fitted tail-dependent specification. Conditional risk measures reveal that Australian D-SIBs form a tightly synchronised contagion cluster in the tail, with limited statistical differentiation in marginal systemic contributions. These findings suggest that dependence structures embedded in regulatory risk assessments may not be invariant across banking systems, particularly in concentrated markets. Our analysis highlights the importance of aligning systemic risk measurement with realised balance-sheet outcomes when designing globally consistent yet locally credible macroprudential frameworks.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用实际信用损失数据（而非市场隐含指标）分析澳大利亚银行业系统性风险，发现尾部依赖的生存克莱顿copula能更好捕捉压力时期的联合损失聚类，表明基于相关性的框架可能低估系统性尾部风险约24%，澳大利亚系统重要性银行在尾部形成紧密同步的传染集群。
AI.research_question: 澳大利亚银行业系统性风险的依赖结构特征是什么？基于实际信用损失而非市场隐含指标的尾部风险测量与相关性框架相比有何差异？
AI.motivation: 现有系统性风险研究多依赖市场隐含指标，可能无法准确反映实际信用损失的真实依赖结构，特别是在集中度高的银行市场。需要基于实际损失数据验证监管风险评估中依赖结构的普适性假设。
AI.theoretical_framework: 系统性风险理论、尾部依赖理论、copula理论（特别是生存克莱顿copula与高斯copula的比较）、巴塞尔III宏观审慎框架、集中市场中的传染机制。
AI.method: 使用巴塞尔III第三支柱披露的实际信用损失数据（2008-2024年），对四家澳大利亚国内系统重要性银行建立厚尾边际损失分布，通过copula结构捕捉银行间依赖关系，进行模型选择比较（尾部依赖vs对称依赖），进行模拟分析风险度量。
AI.findings: 1）模型选择支持尾部依赖的生存克莱顿copula而非对称高斯copula；2）相关性框架可能低估系统性尾部风险约24%；3）澳大利亚D-SIBs在尾部形成紧密同步的传染集群；4）边际系统性贡献缺乏统计显著性差异；5）监管风险评估中的依赖结构在不同银行系统间并非不变。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）验证了在集中银行市场中尾部依赖结构的重要性；2）挑战了依赖结构在不同银行系统间不变的假设；3）为copula选择在系统性风险测量中的应用提供实证证据；4）深化了对实际损失与市场隐含指标差异的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为监管机构提供基于实际损失的系统性风险测量方法；2）揭示相关性框架可能低估风险的程度；3）为澳大利亚等集中市场的宏观审慎政策设计提供依据；4）强调全球一致框架需要结合本地实际情况进行调整。

title: The spatial restructuring of urban economic activities under improved subway accessibility
affiliations: Lanzhou University, Lanzhou University and Zhejiang University - College of Economics

detail.title: The spatial restructuring of urban economic activities under improved subway accessibility
detail.abstract: Subway network construction plays a pivotal role in urban economic development, yet its influence on urban spatial restructuring remains insufficiently studied. Leveraging high-resolution geospatial data of 16,571 1×1 km grid cells, incorporating nighttime light (NTL) data and enterprise registrations data in Beijing from 2007 to 2018, this study quantitatively examines subway-induced urban expansion and structural transformation. Key findings reveal: (1) Each additional subway station stimulates 2.951 km² of urban expansion, accounting for 74-79% of Beijing’s sprawl; (2) Subway development drives a fundamental transition from monocentric to polycentric urban form through sectoral relocation, productive services concentrate in urban cores while manufacturing disperses to suburbs; (3) This spatial reorganization is further reinforced by extended commuting patterns that redistribute consumer services along transit corridors. The results provide empirical evidence of transit infrastructure’s transformative effects on metropolitan spatial structure.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用北京2007-2018年高分辨率地理空间数据，定量分析地铁网络对城市空间重构的影响，发现地铁站建设显著促进城市扩张（每个站点刺激2.951km²扩张），推动城市从单中心向多中心结构转型，并引发产业空间重组。
AI.research_question: 地铁网络建设如何影响城市空间扩张和结构转型？具体而言，地铁发展如何促进城市从单中心向多中心形态转变，并引发产业空间重组？
AI.motivation: 地铁网络建设在城市经济发展中起关键作用，但其对城市空间重构的影响研究不足。现有研究缺乏对地铁如何具体影响城市扩张和空间结构转型的定量分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 城市空间结构理论（单中心vs多中心）、交通导向发展理论、产业区位理论、通勤模式与空间重组理论。
AI.method: 利用北京2007-2018年高分辨率地理空间数据，包括16,571个1×1 km网格单元的夜间灯光数据和企业注册数据，采用定量分析方法研究地铁引发的城市扩张和结构转型。
AI.findings: 1. 每个新增地铁站刺激2.951 km²城市扩张，占北京城市扩张的74-79%；2. 地铁发展推动城市从单中心向多中心形态转变，生产性服务业向城市核心区集中，制造业向郊区分散；3. 通勤模式延长进一步强化空间重组，消费服务业沿交通走廊重新分布。
AI.theory_contributions: 为交通基础设施对城市空间结构的转型效应提供实证证据，深化对地铁网络如何具体影响城市空间重构机制的理解，丰富交通导向发展理论在城市空间结构转型中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为城市规划者提供地铁网络建设对城市空间影响的量化依据，有助于制定更科学的城市交通和土地利用政策，为产业布局优化和城市可持续发展提供决策支持。

title: An Interval Uncertainty Optimization Method Based on Adaptive Dimension Reduction and Subinterval Chebyshev Surrogate Models
affiliations: Chongqing University, Chongqing University, Chongqing University and Chongqing University

detail.title: An Interval Uncertainty Optimization Method Based on Adaptive Dimension Reduction and Subinterval Chebyshev Surrogate Models
detail.abstract: This paper addresses interval uncertainty optimization problems in complex engineering systems by proposing an integrated approach that combines adaptive dimensionality reduction, subinterval decomposition, high-precision Chebyshev surrogate models, and efficient cyclic optimization strategies. To mitigate the curse of dimensionality in high-dimensional uncertainty analysis, the study first introduces a weight adaptation mechanism into the high-dimensional function reduction model, achieving an effective balance between computational complexity and truncation error. Subsequently, it integrates Chebyshev polynomial approximation with subinterval decomposition to construct a high-precision surrogate model that suppresses interval expansion and accommodates large-scale uncertainties. Building upon this, a hybrid optimization strategy combining multi-island genetic algorithms with sequential quadratic programming is designed for the two-layer iterative problem requiring coordinated optimization of interval radii, significantly enhancing computational efficiency and global convergence. Numerical examples and three typical engineering cases validate that the proposed method, while ensuring computational accuracy, demonstrates significant advantages over traditional Chebyshev methods, univariate Chebyshev polynomials, and adaptive dimension-reduction Chebyshev polynomials in computational efficiency and result robustness. This provides an effective solution for designing complex engineering systems with interval uncertainties.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种集成方法来解决复杂工程系统中的区间不确定性优化问题，该方法结合了自适应降维、子区间分解、高精度切比雪夫代理模型和高效循环优化策略，显著提高了计算效率和结果鲁棒性。

title: A review of the evolution of auctions as a method for radio spectrum assignment
affiliations: University of Auckland Business School

detail.title: A review of the evolution of auctions as a method for radio spectrum assignment
detail.abstract: The history of radio spectrum usage is relatively short, but the changes occurred during an even shorter period of time have been remarkable, illustrating how technology keeps testing the ability of policy makers to balance out the interests involved in the utilization of spectrum. Allocating spectrum to particular services and assigning it to commercial operators and non-commercial institutions signify an enormous deal of planning and execution for national spectrum agencies.Auctions have been the main method for assigning the radio spectrum to commercial uses over the last three decades. This paper analyses the evolution of the main challenges spectrum auctions have addressed from its initial applications in the early 1990s until recently. The paper establishes the economic principles motivating the use of auctions and the leading auction formats used worldwide. While not being a survey of auctions on a country-to-country basis or an economic evaluation of auction performance, it focuses on the dominant auction format to reveal how improvements on its rules and constraints answered the fundamental issues that arose from the success and failures of its previous applications.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了无线电频谱拍卖从1990年代初期到最近的主要挑战演变，探讨了拍卖的经济原理和全球主要拍卖格式，重点关注主导拍卖格式如何通过规则和约束的改进来应对先前应用中的成功与失败问题。

title: Trade Credit and SME Productivity: Evidence from China
affiliations: Zhejiang University of Technology, Huazhong University of Science and Technology, Harbin Institute of Technology and Deakin University - Department of Accounting

detail.title: Trade Credit and SME Productivity: Evidence from China
detail.abstract: How to effectively address the issue of long payment durations for small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) constitutes a crucial policy concern for public policymakers globally, especially within developing economies. This paper examines the impact of Article 53 of the SME Promotion Law of the People’s Republic of China (SPL53) on the total factor productivity (TFP) of SMEs. SPL53 accelerates the payment speed of state organs, public institutions, and state-owned enterprises to their SME suppliers. We find that SPL53 leads to a significant increase in the TFP of SMEs. Channel tests indicate that enhanced liquidity resulting from the SPL53 prompts SMEs to increase their capital investment and skilled labor, thereby boosting their TFP. This effect is more pronounced when SMEs are in regions with lower level of government credibility, face higher industrial competition, or have higher costs of switching clients. Finally, SPL53 also exerts a significant positive impact on the aggregate TFP in a region, implying gains in overall productivity. Our findings highlight the significance of accelerating payments in facilitating the growth of SME productivity.

AI.tldr: 该研究发现中国《中小企业促进法》第53条（SPL53）通过加速对中小企业的付款，显著提升了中小企业的全要素生产率（TFP），并促进了区域整体生产率增长。
AI.research_question: 中国《中小企业促进法》第53条（SPL53）对中小企业全要素生产率（TFP）有何影响？
AI.motivation: 中小企业长期面临付款周期长的问题，这对其现金流和运营造成压力，特别是在发展中国家。中国政府通过SPL53政策要求国家机关、事业单位和国有企业加速向中小企业供应商付款，但这一政策对中小企业生产率的影响尚未得到充分研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于资源基础观和流动性约束理论，研究探讨了加速付款如何通过改善企业流动性来影响生产性投资和人力资本配置，进而提升企业生产率。
AI.method: 采用实证分析方法，利用中国中小企业数据，通过双重差分（DID）等方法评估SPL53政策对TFP的影响，并进行渠道检验和异质性分析。
AI.findings:
1. SPL53显著提升了中小企业的TFP
2. 作用渠道：改善的流动性促使中小企业增加资本投资和技能型劳动力投入
3. 异质性效应：在政府信誉较低地区、行业竞争更激烈、客户转换成本更高的中小企业中，政策效果更显著
4. 宏观影响：SPL53对区域整体TFP也有显著正向影响
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 为政府付款政策与企业生产率之间的关系提供了新的理论视角
2. 揭示了流动性改善通过资本投资和人力资本渠道影响生产率的机制
3. 拓展了制度环境（政府信誉、市场竞争）如何调节政策效果的理论理解
AI.practical_contributions:

2. 为中国政府继续完善中小企业支持政策提供了实证支持
3. 为中小企业管理者理解流动性管理对生产率的重要性提供了实践启示

detail.abstract: The state of Uttarakhand, nestled in the Indian Himalayas, has witnessed a significant and sustained migration of its population from the rural hill regions towards urban centers. This paper delves into the multifaceted phenomenon of hill-to-city migration in Uttarakhand, analyzing the primary factors that compel individuals and families to leave their ancestral homes and the attractions that draw them to urban areas. Utilizing authentic data from research papers, government reports, and census records, this study examines the trends and patterns of this migration, including the demographic profile of migrants and their destinations. Furthermore, it assesses the profound socio-economic and environmental impacts of this population movement on both the sparsely populated hill regions and the burgeoning urban spaces. The findings underscore the complex interplay of economic disparities, infrastructural deficiencies, environmental stressors, and evolving social aspirations that fuel this migration. The analysis concludes by highlighting the urgent need for targeted policy interventions to address the root causes of out-migration from the hills and to foster sustainable and balanced regional development within Uttarakhand.

title: Who Are "the Parties" for Purposes of VCLT Article 31(3)(c)? A Case Study in WTO Pragmatism

detail.title: Who Are "the Parties" for Purposes of VCLT Article 31(3)(c)? A Case Study in WTO Pragmatism

keywords: vienna convention on the law of treaties

publicationDetails.detailsText: Revue québécoise de droit international, 2025[10.7202/1121453ar]

detail.abstract: Article 31(3)(c) of the Vienna Convention on the Law of Treaties (VCLT) provides that a treaty interpreter must take into account “any relevant rules of international law applicable in the relations between the parties.” The meaning of “the parties,” and more specifically whether there is a precondition that all parties to the treaty being interpreted must also be parties to the other treaty for the latter to qualify under Article 31(3)(c), has been the subject of much academic debate. The question does not necessarily have an obvious answer, and has been seen as being a consequential issue in the WTO context because of a perception among some commentators that: (a) taking non-WTO treaties into account could be a decisive consideration in the interpretation of certain WTO provisions; and (ii) under a strict reading of “the parties”, very few non-WTO treaties would meet the requisite threshold. This article explains how WTO adjudicators have pragmatically bypassed and largely defused this contentious issue by referring to non-WTO treaties effectively as “supplementary means” of interpretation, or, more commonly, as evidence of facts—purposes that arguably could fall outside the purview of Article 31(3)(c).

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了《维也纳条约法公约》第31(3)(c)条中"当事方"的含义争议，特别是WTO争端解决中如何实际处理非WTO条约的援引问题。
AI.research_question: 《维也纳条约法公约》第31(3)(c)条中的"当事方"是否要求条约解释所涉及的所有当事方都必须是相关国际法规则的缔约方？
AI.motivation: 该问题在WTO背景下尤为重要，因为如果严格解释"当事方"要求，很少有非WTO条约能满足条件，但忽视这些条约又可能影响WTO条款的正确解释。
AI.theoretical_framework: 《维也纳条约法公约》第31(3)(c)条的条约解释规则，国际法体系整合理论，WTO争端解决机制的法律解释实践。
AI.method: 法律文本分析、WTO争端解决案例研究、学术文献综述。
AI.findings: WTO裁决机构通过将非WTO条约作为"补充解释手段"或事实证据来实用性地绕过这一争议，避免了直接适用第31(3)(c)条的严格门槛要求。
AI.theory_contributions: 澄清了《维也纳条约法公约》第31(3)(c)条在实践中的灵活适用方式，揭示了国际法体系整合的实际操作机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为WTO争端解决实践提供了绕过"当事方"争议的实用策略，使非WTO条约能在WTO解释中发挥作用而不受严格形式要求的限制。

title: Estimating Electric Vehicle Miles Traveled: a Bayesian Hierarchical Spatial Zero-Inflated Beta Model
affiliations: University of Washington and University of Washington

detail.title: Estimating Electric Vehicle Miles Traveled: a Bayesian Hierarchical Spatial Zero-Inflated Beta Model
detail.abstract: Quantifying electric vehicle (EV) usage at high spatial resolution is essential for charging infrastructure planning. However, public household travel surveys typically contain sparse EV observations with excessive zeros, particularly during early adoption stages. This study proposes a Bayesian hierarchical spatial zero-inflated beta model to estimate electric vehicle miles traveled (EVMT) as a proportion of total person miles traveled at the census tract level. The model explicitly addresses data sparsity, zero-inflation, and spatial dependence, while maintaining interpretability and enabling uncertainty quantification. Applied to a 2023 regional household travel survey in the U.S., where 84% of sampled tracts reported zero EV miles, the model produced reliable tract-level estimates with calibrated uncertainty (92% credible interval coverage). The resulting estimates support policy evaluation, charging demand prediction, and transportation-related emissions assessment. The proposed model is generalizable to other household travel surveys and provides a practical, scalable methodology for estimating EV usage across diverse regional contexts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种贝叶斯层次空间零膨胀beta模型，用于在人口普查区层面估计电动汽车行驶里程占总个人行驶里程的比例，解决了早期采用阶段EV数据稀疏、零值过多和空间依赖性问题。

AI.theoretical_framework: 贝叶斯层次建模、空间统计、零膨胀模型、beta回归模型。该研究结合了零膨胀模型处理过多零值、beta回归处理比例数据、空间模型处理空间依赖性的理论框架。
AI.method: 提出了一种贝叶斯层次空间零膨胀beta模型，该模型明确处理数据稀疏性、零膨胀和空间依赖性，同时保持可解释性并支持不确定性量化。应用于2023年美国区域家庭出行调查数据。
AI.findings: 在84%的抽样区域报告零EV里程的调查中，该模型产生了可靠的人口普查区层面估计，具有校准的不确定性（92%可信区间覆盖率）。估计结果支持政策评估、充电需求预测和交通相关排放评估。
AI.theory_contributions: 开发了一种新的贝叶斯层次空间零膨胀beta模型，为处理稀疏、零值过多的空间比例数据提供了理论框架，扩展了空间统计和零膨胀模型的应用范围。
AI.practical_contributions: 为规划者提供了实用的、可扩展的方法论，用于在不同区域背景下估计EV使用量，支持充电基础设施规划、政策评估和排放评估等实际应用。

detail.title: The Effects of Cultural Institutes on Bilateral Trade
detail.abstract: This paper uses the locations of cultural institute (CI) networks to estimate the culture-trade effect. We estimate a structural gravity model using data for 30 CI networks for 1985-2024. Our variable of interest is the number of foreign offices operated by the source in the host country. Our results show that an increase in CI foreign offices is associated with greater exports of aggregate and core cultural goods (such as books, recorded music, visual arts) from host to source.

detail.title: Gutterman's Business Counselor's Guide to Organizational Management: Volume 2
detail.abstract:
Alan Gutterman’s Business Counselor’s Guide to Organizational Management is a comprehensive and practical resource on the management and administration of organizations.  While its primary emphasis is on business enterprises—particularly growth-oriented companies seeking to scale and operate in increasingly complex and global environments—the concepts and guidance presented here are applicable to a broad range of organizations, including nonprofit and hybrid entities.

This work is intended for a diverse audience that includes entrepreneurs, executives, functional leaders, and managers responsible for shaping organizational performance and professional advisors who support them. Topics such as organizational design, entrepreneurship, governance, compliance, global expansion, and managing change are addressed in a pragmatic manner intended to resonate with readers who must translate theory into action.

This second volume covers horizontal business processes, vertical business functions, international business activities, managing growth and change, and comparative management studies.  The first volume, available separately on SSRN as Business Counselor's Guide to Organizational Management: Volume 1, introduces foundational themes across four core areas: organizational studies, management and leadership, launching and growing new businesses, and governance and compliance.  

This publication is intended to support thoughtful, informed leadership. Organizations do not succeed by accident; they are intentionally designed and continuously refined. By integrating legal awareness with management insight, this work aims to help leaders and advisors build organizations that are resilient, adaptive, and capable of sustained success.

title: FloodDT: An AI-empowered Real-time and Predictive Flood Digital Twin on a Web-based GIS Platform
affiliations: University of Technology Sydney (UTS), affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, University of Adelaide, affiliation not provided to SSRN and University of Technology Sydney (UTS)

detail.title: FloodDT: An AI-empowered Real-time and Predictive Flood Digital Twin on a Web-based GIS Platform
detail.abstract: Floods are among the most destructive natural hazards worldwide, making accurate and practical flood forecasting essential for early warning, risk assessment, and emergency response. However, traditional simulation-based platforms rely on computationally intensive hydrodynamic models, resulting in limited responsiveness and inefficient visualisation. This paper presents FloodDT, a full-stack, AI-empowered Flood Digital Twin platform that overcomes these limitations. It integrates advanced AI modelling, multimodal data processing, real-time interaction, and efficient GIS-based visualisation within a modular architecture combining a Vue 3 + DeckGL frontend with a FastAPI asynchronous backend. Powered by an advanced FloodTransformer model, FloodDT is capable of producing high-resolution, multi-step flood forecasts over large geographic regions. Extensive optimisation strategies further enable the system low-latency, high-throughput, and stable concurrent performance. A case study in the Wagga Wagga catchment in Australia demonstrates FloodDT’s effectiveness for real-time, accurate forecasting and intuitive exploration of historical flood events, supporting practical decision-making in emergency management.

AI.tldr: FloodDT是一个基于AI的洪水数字孪生平台，通过集成先进AI模型、多模态数据处理和实时交互，实现高效、高分辨率的洪水预测，克服传统模拟方法计算量大、响应慢的问题。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一个高效、准确且实用的AI驱动的洪水数字孪生平台，以克服传统洪水预测方法的计算密集、响应慢和可视化效率低的问题？
AI.motivation: 洪水是全球最具破坏性的自然灾害之一，传统基于模拟的洪水预测平台依赖计算密集的水动力模型，导致响应能力有限且可视化效率低下，需要更高效、实用的解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数字孪生理论、AI驱动的洪水预测模型（FloodTransformer）、多模态数据处理框架、实时交互系统理论、高效可视化理论。
AI.method: 采用模块化架构设计，前端使用Vue 3 + DeckGL，后端使用FastAPI异步框架；开发FloodTransformer AI模型进行洪水预测；实施多模态数据处理和实时交互；采用澳大利亚Wagga Wagga流域的案例研究进行验证。
AI.findings: FloodDT平台能够在大范围地理区域内生成高分辨率、多步骤的洪水预测；通过优化策略实现低延迟、高吞吐量和稳定的并发性能；案例研究表明该平台在实时准确预测和历史洪水事件直观探索方面具有有效性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了AI赋能的洪水数字孪生平台理论框架；开发了FloodTransformer模型用于洪水预测；建立了多模态数据处理与实时交互的理论模型；为数字孪生在自然灾害管理中的应用提供了理论支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了实用的洪水预测平台，支持早期预警、风险评估和应急响应；提供了高效的可视化工具帮助决策制定；通过案例验证了系统在实际应急管理中的有效性；为洪水灾害管理提供了技术解决方案。

title: Joint Pilot Allocation and AP Selection for Massive Access in Cell-Free Massive MIMO
affiliations: Hanyang University, Hanyang University, Hanyang University, Hanyang University and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Joint Pilot Allocation and AP Selection for Massive Access in Cell-Free Massive MIMO
detail.abstract: With the exponential growth of connected devices, cell-free massive multiple-input multiple-output (CF-mMIMO) systems have emerged as a promising solution to overcome the limitations of traditional cellular networks. This paper proposes a novel access point (AP) clustering scheme in massive CF-mMIMO. Addressing the critical issue of pilot contamination, this study introduces a max-min distance-based pilot allocation (MMDP) scheme to enhance spectral efficiency (SE) by minimizing the error in channel estimation. Additionally, a novel greedy AP selection scheme is presented that enables centralized decisions to maximize SE and addresses the limitations of the scalable CF-mMIMO scheme. The simulation results confirm the performance gains of the proposed scheme, showing an improvement of up to 14% in the 95%-likely SE compared to the scalable CF-mMIMO scheme.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新颖的接入点聚类方案，结合最大最小距离导频分配和贪婪AP选择算法，以提升大规模无蜂窝MIMO系统的频谱效率，相比可扩展方案可提升14%的95%可能频谱效率。
AI.research_question: 如何在大规模无蜂窝MIMO系统中设计有效的接入点聚类和导频分配方案，以减轻导频污染并最大化频谱效率？
AI.motivation: 随着连接设备的指数增长，传统蜂窝网络存在局限性，无蜂窝大规模MIMO系统成为有前景的解决方案，但面临导频污染等关键问题需要解决。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于大规模无蜂窝MIMO系统理论，结合导频污染分析、信道估计误差最小化理论，以及频谱效率最大化原则。
AI.method: 提出最大最小距离导频分配方案以最小化信道估计误差，并设计贪婪AP选择算法进行集中式决策，通过仿真验证性能。
AI.findings: 仿真结果显示，所提方案相比可扩展无蜂窝MIMO方案，在95%可能频谱效率方面提升了高达14%。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了新颖的AP聚类理论框架，发展了基于最大最小距离的导频分配理论，完善了无蜂窝MIMO系统中的资源分配理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为实际无蜂窝MIMO系统部署提供了有效的AP聚类和导频分配方案，显著提升系统频谱效率，具有实际应用价值。

title: The Impact of Green Bond Issuance on Corporate Greenwashing Behavior
affiliations: Shandong University of Finance and Economics, Shandong University of Finance and Economics and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: The Impact of Green Bond Issuance on Corporate Greenwashing Behavior
detail.abstract: Against the backdrop of the rapid expansion of the green bond market, this study employs data from A-share listed companies on the Shanghai and Shenzhen Stock Exchanges spanning the period 2015 - 2023 and adopts a staggered difference - in - differences model to assess the policy effects of green bond issuance, with a primary focus on exploring how green bond issuance influences corporate greenwashing behavior. The findings are as follows. Firstly, green bond issuance significantly curbs corporate greenwashing practices. Secondly, the mediating effect test reveals that green bond issuance can inhibit corporate greenwashing by boosting environmental investment and strengthening media supervision. Thirdly, the moderating effect test indicates that both the intensity of market competition and the public's attention to environmental issues can positively moderate the inhibitory effect of green bond issuance on corporate greenwashing. Fourthly, the heterogeneity test shows that the inhibitory effect of green bond issuance on greenwashing is more pronounced among state - owned enterprises, enterprises with environmental certifications, and those operating in non - heavily polluting industries. The conclusions of this research hold certain theoretical significance for a comprehensive understanding of the environmental effects of green bond issuance and for promoting policy optimization.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用2015-2023年沪深A股上市公司数据，采用交错双重差分模型评估绿色债券发行的政策效应，发现绿色债券发行能显著抑制企业绿色漂白行为，主要通过增加环境投资和加强媒体监督实现，市场竞争强度和环境关注度正向调节这一效应，且对国企、有环境认证企业和非重污染行业企业效果更明显。
AI.research_question: 绿色债券发行如何影响企业绿色漂白行为？
AI.motivation: 在绿色债券市场快速扩张的背景下，需要全面理解绿色债券发行的环境效应，特别是其对遏制企业绿色漂白行为的作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于绿色金融理论、企业社会责任理论和信号理论，探讨绿色债券发行对企业环境行为的影响机制。
AI.method: 使用2015-2023年沪深A股上市公司数据，采用交错双重差分模型评估绿色债券发行的政策效应。
AI.findings: 1. 绿色债券发行显著抑制企业绿色漂白行为；2. 通过增加环境投资和加强媒体监督实现抑制作用；3. 市场竞争强度和环境关注度正向调节这一效应；4. 对国企、有环境认证企业和非重污染行业企业效果更明显。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对绿色债券环境效应的理论理解，揭示了绿色债券抑制企业绿色漂白的作用机制，丰富了绿色金融与企业环境行为关系的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者优化绿色债券政策提供依据，为企业绿色转型提供参考，为投资者评估企业环境表现提供指导，促进绿色债券市场的健康发展。

title: Corporate Climate Change and Financial Performance: The Critical Role of Corporate Governance
affiliations: MBS School of Business, Ton Duc Thang University and Ton Duc Thang University

detail.title: Corporate Climate Change and Financial Performance: The Critical Role of Corporate Governance
detail.abstract: This study examines the relationship between corporate climate change performance and financial outcomes. Using a sample of 749 Asian firms from 2013 to 2023, we analyse two dimensions of climate change performance - management and exposure - based on MSCI data and the framework proposed by Sautner [73]. Panel data regression results indicate that effective climate change management is positively associated with corporate financial performance, whereas climate change exposure is negatively associated. Importantly, corporate governance plays a moderating role in this relationship. The paper analyses the relevant implications of these findings for firms, investors, and regulators.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了亚洲企业气候变化绩效与财务表现的关系，发现有效的气候变化管理与财务绩效正相关，而气候变化暴露则负相关，且公司治理在其中起调节作用。
AI.research_question: 企业气候变化绩效（包括管理和暴露两个维度）如何影响财务表现？公司治理在这一关系中起什么作用？
AI.motivation: 随着气候变化问题日益重要，企业面临的气候相关风险和机遇对财务表现的影响尚不明确，特别是在亚洲市场背景下需要实证研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Sautner[73]的气候变化绩效框架，将气候变化绩效分为管理和暴露两个维度，结合公司治理理论探讨调节作用。
AI.method: 使用749家亚洲企业2013-2023年的面板数据，基于MSCI数据衡量气候变化绩效，采用面板数据回归分析。
AI.findings: 1. 有效的气候变化管理与财务绩效正相关；2. 气候变化暴露与财务绩效负相关；3. 公司治理在气候变化绩效与财务表现关系中起调节作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 验证了气候变化绩效二维框架在亚洲市场的适用性；2. 揭示了公司治理在气候-财务关系中的调节机制；3. 丰富了可持续发展与企业财务表现的理论联系。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为企业提供气候变化管理的财务价值证据；2. 帮助投资者识别气候相关风险和机会；3. 为监管机构制定气候信息披露政策提供参考。

title: A GIS-Based Optimal Design Method for District Cooling System Pipe Networks
affiliations: South China University of Technology, South China University of Technology and South China University of Technology

detail.title: A GIS-Based Optimal Design Method for District Cooling System Pipe Networks
detail.abstract: The district cooling system (DCS) is recognized as a promising cooling solution due to its high efficiency and flexible configuration capabilities. However, identifying optimal plant locations and pipe network layouts poses a major challenge in implementing DCS. This is particularly critical for multi-station networks involving complex spatial and hydraulic constraints, where suboptimal design significantly impacts the system's performance and benefits. To address these issues, this study proposes a two-stage optimization method for GIS-based DCS pipeline network design, which simultaneously considers both multi-site location selection and pipeline routing design processes.In the first stage, the K-Medoids clustering algorithm is employed to scientifically partition cooling service ranges and determine the optimal quantity of stations within the region. In the second stage, the Non-dominated Sorting Genetic Algorithm II (NSGA-II), integrated with graph theory, is applied to conduct a multi-objective optimization of the pipe network layout.Based on this proposed methodology, an empirical analysis was conducted using a high-potential commercial and office district in Shenzhen as a case study. The results indicate that for both the random station distribution and preset candidate site scenarios, a configuration where cooling load clusters are partitioned into four distinct service ranges proves to be the most appropriate. Through the multi-objective design of each cooling load cluster under both scenarios, Pareto front solution sets representing the trade-off between minimum total cost and minimum system maximum pressure drop were obtained. Subsequently, the comprehensive optimal scheme was identified using the EWM-TOPSIS method.From an engineering perspective, this approach allows decision-makers to select varying pipe network layout schemes tailored to specific project requirements. Case verification demonstrates that the constructed multi-station network optimization method is capable of generating multi-objective solutions across different scenarios, thereby providing robust technical support for network planning and significantly enhancing decision-making efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出一个两阶段优化方法，用于基于GIS的区域供冷系统管网设计，同时考虑多站点选址和管道路由设计。第一阶段使用K-Medoids聚类算法划分供冷服务范围并确定最优站点数量；第二阶段使用NSGA-II算法结合图论进行管网布局的多目标优化。通过深圳某商业办公区的案例验证，该方法能为决策者提供多种管网布局方案选择。
AI.research_question: 如何在考虑复杂空间和水力约束的情况下，为多站点区域供冷系统优化确定最佳的站点位置和管网布局？
AI.motivation: 区域供冷系统因其高效率和灵活配置能力被认为是前景广阔的供冷解决方案，但在实施过程中，确定最优的站点位置和管网布局面临重大挑战。特别是对于涉及复杂空间和水力约束的多站点网络，次优设计会显著影响系统性能和效益。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本研究基于运筹学、图论和多目标优化理论，结合地理信息系统（GIS）技术，构建了一个综合的管网设计框架。理论框架包括聚类分析（K-Medoids）、多目标遗传算法（NSGA-II）和多准则决策方法（EWM-TOPSIS）。
AI.method: 提出两阶段优化方法：第一阶段使用K-Medoids聚类算法科学划分供冷服务范围并确定区域内最优站点数量；第二阶段将非支配排序遗传算法II（NSGA-II）与图论结合，进行管网布局的多目标优化。最后使用EWM-TOPSIS方法确定综合最优方案。
AI.findings: 对于随机站点分布和预设候选站点两种情景，将供冷负荷聚类划分为四个独立服务范围是最合适的配置。通过两种情景下各供冷负荷聚类的多目标设计，获得了代表最小总成本与最小系统最大压降之间权衡的帕累托前沿解集。
AI.theory_contributions: 理论上，本研究提出了一个结合聚类分析、多目标优化和图论的综合管网设计框架，为区域供冷系统规划提供了新的方法论。将NSGA-II算法与图论结合应用于管网布局优化，扩展了多目标优化在工程规划中的应用范围。
AI.practical_contributions: 从工程角度，该方法允许决策者根据具体项目需求选择不同的管网布局方案。构建的多站点网络优化方法能够生成不同情景下的多目标解集，为网络规划提供稳健的技术支持，显著提高决策效率。案例验证表明该方法在实际工程中具有应用价值。

title: Material Flow Analysis and Carbon Footprint Assessment: In search of a low-impact, circular management approach to end-of-life electronics
affiliations: Hong Kong University of Science & Technology (HKUST), Hong Kong University of Science & Technology (HKUST), Hong Kong University of Science & Technology (HKUST) - HKUST Institute for Emerging Market Studies (IEMS) and University of Bath

detail.title: Material Flow Analysis and Carbon Footprint Assessment: In search of a low-impact, circular management approach to end-of-life electronics
detail.abstract: This study combines Material Flow Analysis (MFA) and Carbon Footprint Assessment (CFA) to explore a low-impact, circular management approach to EOL electronics. Household surveys (n = 796) and dealer interviews (n = 35) estimate about 101,854 tonnes of discarded electronics generated annually. According to MFA, 34.87% are formally recycled locally, with major contributions coming from storage (15.49%), export for recycle (14.06%), repair (14.03%), export for reuse (10.97%), reuse in local (10.58%), and landfill (1.5%), highlighting inadequate formal collection. CFA demonstrated that reuse and repair yield the largest carbon savings among CE strategies. According to future scenario analysis using Shared Socioeconomic Pathways, sustainable policies (SSP1) can reduce up to -12,497,568.15 tonnes CO2eq by 2050. To achieve zero landfills in 2035 and carbon neutrality before 2050, policy innovation that emphasizes producer responsibility scheme, strengthens and supports circular strategies such as repair, reuse and refurbishment, and encourages public engagement is crucial.

AI.tldr: 本研究结合物质流分析和碳足迹评估，探索电子废弃物低影响循环管理方法。研究发现尼泊尔每年产生约101,854吨电子废弃物，仅34.87%被正规回收，主要流向存储、出口回收、维修等。碳足迹分析显示维修和再利用的碳减排效益最大。未来情景分析表明可持续政策到2050年可减少近1250万吨CO2当量排放。
AI.research_question: 如何通过循环经济策略实现电子废弃物的低影响管理，并评估不同管理路径的碳减排潜力？
AI.motivation: 电子废弃物快速增长带来环境和资源挑战，需要探索有效的循环管理方法，特别是发展中国家缺乏正规回收体系的问题。研究旨在为尼泊尔等发展中国家提供电子废弃物管理的科学依据和政策建议。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结合物质流分析（MFA）和碳足迹评估（CFA）的理论框架，采用循环经济原则，分析电子废弃物的全生命周期环境影响。
AI.method: 采用混合研究方法：1）家庭调查（n=796）和经销商访谈（n=35）估算电子废弃物产生量；2）物质流分析追踪废弃物流向；3）碳足迹评估比较不同管理策略的环境影响；4）共享社会经济路径（SSP）情景分析预测未来减排潜力。
AI.findings: 1）尼泊尔每年产生约101,854吨电子废弃物；2）仅34.87%被正规回收，主要流向存储（15.49%）、出口回收（14.06%）、维修（14.03%）等；3）维修和再利用的碳减排效益最大；4）可持续政策情景（SSP1）到2050年可减少近1250万吨CO2当量排放。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）将MFA和CFA方法结合应用于发展中国家电子废弃物管理研究；2）量化不同循环经济策略的碳减排效益；3）为循环经济理论在电子废弃物管理中的应用提供实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为尼泊尔电子废弃物管理提供数据支持；2）识别维修和再利用为最有效的碳减排策略；3）提出政策建议：强化生产者责任制度、支持维修/再利用/翻新策略、鼓励公众参与，以实现2035年零填埋和2050年碳中和目标。

title: Geopolitical risk and stock market volatility across developed, emerging, and frontier markets
affiliations: University of Economics in Bratislava and University of Economics in Bratislava

detail.title: Geopolitical risk and stock market volatility across developed, emerging, and frontier markets
detail.abstract: Geopolitical risk (GPR) affects stock market volatility through multiple transmission channels; however, volatility dynamics in frontier markets differ from those in developed and emerging economies due to weaker institutional frameworks and less developed financial systems. This study provides a comparative analysis of developed, emerging, and frontier markets, examining the relationship between stock market volatility and aggregate geopolitical risk (GPR) as well as its components: geopolitical acts (GPRA) and geopolitical threats (GPRT) over June 2002 to April 2025. We focus on dependence, risk transmission, and spillovers across time, investment horizons and GPR regimes. The results indicate a generally weak volatility-GPR relationship across all market segments, with frontier markets exhibiting the weakest dependence throughout. At short investment horizons, volatility is mildly negatively associated with all GPR categories, while at longer horizons the relationship turns positive as geopolitical risk is gradually priced into volatility. Frontier markets emerge as net recipients of volatility spillovers from GPR and GPRA, although spillover magnitudes remain smaller than in developed markets. The volatility-GPR relationship is also regime dependent: under low-risk conditions, volatility is more closely associated with GPRT, whereas under high-risk conditions it is most strongly linked to GPRA, reflecting the transmission of concrete economic disruptions. Our findings indicate that risk management should account for horizon- and regime-specific dynamics, and that GPR measures developed for advanced markets may not be directly applicable to frontier economies.

AI.tldr: 本研究比较了发达、新兴和前沿市场的股票市场波动性与地缘政治风险（GPR）的关系，发现整体关系较弱，前沿市场最弱。短期投资视野下波动性与GPR呈轻微负相关，长期则转为正相关。前沿市场是GPR波动溢出的净接收者，且关系具有风险状态依赖性。
AI.research_question: 发达、新兴和前沿市场的股票市场波动性与地缘政治风险（GPR）及其组成部分（地缘政治行为GPRA和地缘政治威胁GPRT）的关系有何差异？这种关系如何随时间、投资视野和GPR状态变化？
AI.motivation: 地缘政治风险通过多种渠道影响股市波动，但前沿市场由于制度框架较弱和金融系统不发达，其波动动态与发达和新兴经济体不同。现有研究缺乏对这三类市场的比较分析，特别是关于GPR不同组成部分的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于地缘政治风险理论、市场效率理论和波动溢出理论，探讨不同市场类型（发达、新兴、前沿）在制度框架和金融发展水平差异下，对GPR冲击的响应机制和风险传导路径。
AI.method: 采用比较分析方法，研究2002年6月至2025年4月期间发达、新兴和前沿市场的股票市场波动性与GPR的关系。分析依赖关系、风险传导和溢出效应，考虑时间维度、投资视野和GPR状态变化。
AI.findings: 1. 所有市场类型的波动-GPR关系整体较弱，前沿市场最弱；2. 短期投资视野下波动性与GPR呈轻微负相关，长期转为正相关；3. 前沿市场是GPR和GPRA波动溢出的净接收者；4. 低风险状态下波动性与GPRT关联更强，高风险状态下与GPRA关联最强。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次系统比较三类市场对GPR的响应差异；2. 揭示了投资视野对波动-GPR关系的影响机制；3. 识别了GPR不同组成部分在不同风险状态下的作用差异；4. 为前沿市场的特殊风险传导机制提供理论解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 风险管理应考虑视野和状态特定的动态；2. 针对发达市场开发的GPR指标可能不适用于前沿经济体；3. 为投资者提供跨市场风险配置的决策依据；4. 为政策制定者提供市场稳定性的管理参考。

title: A Multi-Dimensional Feedback Engine for Governed Adaptation in Human-in-the-Loop Predictive Maintenance
affiliations: University of Derby

detail.title: A Multi-Dimensional Feedback Engine for Governed Adaptation in Human-in-the-Loop Predictive Maintenance
detail.abstract: When Predictive Maintenance (PdM) models must adapt to new operational priorities, we need to manage this process carefully. The main problem is that models can forget previously learned failure patterns, which reduces their usefulness. This paper proposes the Multi-Dimensional Feedback (MDF) Engine. This is an architectural pattern that structures human feedback for PdM systems into three levels: correcting specific predictions, validating model behavior patterns, and providing strategic guidance. The goal is to allow controlled model updates. We tested this approach using a simulation with the NASA C-MAPSS dataset. We created a scenario where the system's priority changes from saving costs to ensuring safety. The results show that our MDF method kept the model's performance utility stable. In contrast, the traditional method of retraining a new model from scratch caused a 67% drop in utility. Our method also used much less expert data - only 95 feedback samples, which is 210 times less data than full retraining. This work shows a structured way to use human feedback, helping PdM systems stay reliable when operational goals change.

AI.tldr: 本文提出多维度反馈引擎(MDF)，通过结构化人类反馈的三个层次（修正预测、验证模式、战略指导），在预测性维护系统优先级变化时实现可控模型更新，相比传统重训练方法显著减少性能损失和数据需求。
AI.research_question: 如何在预测性维护系统面临运营优先级变化时，通过结构化人类反馈实现可控的模型更新，避免模型遗忘先前学习到的故障模式？
AI.motivation: 预测性维护模型在适应新的运营优先级时，传统方法（如重新训练新模型）会导致模型遗忘先前学习的故障模式，造成性能显著下降。需要一种能够平衡新旧知识、实现可控更新的方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于人类反馈的机器学习、持续学习、模型适应理论，以及预测性维护系统的架构设计原则。
AI.method: 提出多维度反馈引擎(MDF)架构模式，将人类反馈结构化分为三个层次：具体预测修正、模型行为模式验证、战略指导。使用NASA C-MAPSS数据集进行模拟实验，创建从成本节约到安全保障的优先级变化场景。
AI.findings: MDF方法能保持模型性能效用稳定，而传统从头训练新模型的方法导致效用下降67%。MDF仅需95个反馈样本，比完全重新训练少210倍的数据量。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了结构化人类反馈的三层框架，为预测性维护系统的适应性更新提供了理论架构；扩展了持续学习理论在工业应用中的实践方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一种实用的架构模式，帮助企业在运营优先级变化时保持预测性维护系统的可靠性；显著减少了专家数据需求和模型更新成本。

title: Thermal constraint assessment method and application based on satellite thermal balance theory
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Harbin Institute of Technology

detail.title: Thermal constraint assessment method and application based on satellite thermal balance theory
detail.abstract: Effective on-orbit mission planning is of great importance to enhance the operational efficiency of remote sensing satellites. These satellites perform tasks such as imaging, data compression and transmission, all of which are subject to a variety of limitations, including energy constraints, terrestrial constraints and thermal constraints. As satellite constellations become increasingly prevalent, mission planning accounts for a rapidly growing proportion throughout the running period within satellite control systems. To reduce the complexity of mission planning, this paper facilitated the thermal constraint into a post-planning verification process and proposed a thermal constraint assessment method (TCAM). First of all, this study simplified the thermal balance theory for the specific device by applying mathematical techniques. So as to establish TCAM, the concept of thermal surplus (Ps) was proposed. We further developed TCAM to the Jilin-1 satellites on-orbit mission planning. Over 15 orbital cycles, the highest temperature of the data process unit exhibited a strong correlation with Ps, while consistently remaining within the permissible thermal limit. The results demonstrated the effectiveness and feasibility of TCAM.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种热约束评估方法（TCAM），将热约束转化为后规划验证过程，简化了遥感卫星在轨任务规划的复杂性。通过热剩余（Ps）概念和热平衡理论简化，应用于吉林一号卫星任务规划，验证了方法的有效性和可行性。
AI.research_question: 如何有效简化遥感卫星在轨任务规划中的热约束处理，提高规划效率？
AI.motivation: 随着卫星星座日益普及，任务规划在卫星控制系统运行期间占比快速增长。遥感卫星执行成像、数据压缩和传输等任务时面临能量、地面和热约束等多种限制，热约束处理增加了规划复杂性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 热平衡理论、热约束评估方法（TCAM）、热剩余（Ps）概念
AI.method: 1. 将热约束转化为后规划验证过程；2. 应用数学技术简化特定设备的热平衡理论；3. 提出热剩余（Ps）概念建立TCAM；4. 将TCAM应用于吉林一号卫星在轨任务规划；5. 通过15个轨道周期验证方法有效性
AI.findings: 1. 数据处理单元的最高温度与热剩余（Ps）呈现强相关性；2. 温度始终保持在允许的热限值范围内；3. TCAM在吉林一号卫星任务规划中表现出有效性和可行性
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出热约束评估方法（TCAM）理论框架；2. 引入热剩余（Ps）概念作为热约束评估指标；3. 将热平衡理论简化为适用于卫星任务规划的实用方法
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 简化了遥感卫星在轨任务规划的复杂性；2. 提高了卫星任务规划的操作效率；3. 为卫星星座的任务规划提供了实用的热约束评估工具；4. 验证了方法在实际卫星系统（吉林一号）中的可行性

title: A Fuzzy MCDM-Based Framework for Evaluating and Prioritizing ITS Toward Sustainable Urban Mobility
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: A Fuzzy MCDM-Based Framework for Evaluating and Prioritizing ITS Toward Sustainable Urban Mobility
detail.abstract: As global concerns over sustainability, congestion, and environmental degradation escalate, urban areas are increasingly turning to Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS) to foster more sustainable mobility. This study aims to evaluate and prioritize ITS alternatives that can contribute effectively to environmental, social, and economic sustainability. A hybrid Multi-Criteria Decision-Making (MCDM) framework is employed, integrating the Fuzzy Analytic Hierarchy Process (Fuzzy AHP), validated through bootstrap resampling, for deriving criteria weights, with the Fuzzy Combined Compromise Solution (Fuzzy CoCoSo) method for prioritizing ITS alternatives. The evaluation incorporates 16 subcriteria across six main dimensions: environmental impact, safety, technical feasibility, economic viability, social inclusivity, and operational performance. To validate the findings, robustness is assessed through a comparative analysis using Fuzzy TOPSIS, Fuzzy VIKOR and Fuzzy CODAS, with rankings compared via Spearman’s rank correlation. Sensitivity analysis is also conducted to measure the influence of variations in decision parameters. The results identify Adaptive Traffic Signal Control as the top-priority ITS alternative for the Tunisian context, followed by Incident Detection and Management Systems and Transit Signal Priority. The study offers a reliable, structured methodology to support decision-makers in formulating policies aligned with sustainable urban mobility objectives.

AI.tldr: 本研究采用混合多准则决策框架（模糊AHP+模糊CoCoSo），评估并优先排序能促进环境、社会和经济可持续性的智能交通系统替代方案。在突尼斯情境下，自适应交通信号控制被确定为最高优先级的ITS方案。
AI.research_question: 如何评估和优先排序能够有效促进环境、社会和经济可持续性的智能交通系统替代方案？
AI.motivation: 随着全球对可持续性、拥堵和环境退化的关注日益增加，城市地区越来越多地转向智能交通系统以促进更可持续的出行。需要一种系统方法来评估和优先排序ITS替代方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多准则决策理论、模糊集理论、层次分析法、可持续交通理论、城市可持续性框架
AI.method: 混合多准则决策框架：模糊层次分析法（通过bootstrap重采样验证）用于确定准则权重，模糊组合妥协解方法用于优先排序ITS替代方案。评估包含6个主要维度下的16个子准则。通过模糊TOPSIS、模糊VIKOR和模糊CODAS进行稳健性验证，使用Spearman秩相关比较排名，并进行敏感性分析。
AI.findings: 在突尼斯情境下，自适应交通信号控制被确定为最高优先级的ITS替代方案，其次是事件检测和管理系统，以及公交信号优先。研究提供了可靠的结构化方法，支持决策者制定符合可持续城市出行目标的政策。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 开发了一个整合模糊AHP和模糊CoCoSo的混合MCDM框架；2. 将bootstrap重采样验证引入模糊AHP权重确定过程；3. 提出了一个包含环境、社会、经济等多维度的ITS可持续性评估框架；4. 通过多种MCDM方法和统计检验验证了方法的稳健性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为城市决策者提供了评估和优先排序ITS替代方案的系统工具；2. 确定了突尼斯情境下的ITS实施优先级；3. 支持政策制定者制定符合可持续城市出行目标的政策；4. 方法可推广到其他城市和地区的ITS规划中。

title: A Bayesian-optimized LightGBM approach for reliable cooling load forecasting in data centers
affiliations: Hunan University of Technology, Hunan University of Technology, Hunan University, Hunan University of Technology and Hunan University of Technology

detail.title: A Bayesian-optimized LightGBM approach for reliable cooling load forecasting in data centers
detail.abstract: With the rapid advancement of information technology, the energy consumption of data centers has become a critical issue. Accurate cooling load prediction is essential for optimizing cooling system operations and improving energy efficiency. However, conventional models often struggle to capture the complex nonlinearities and multi-variable coupling effects inherent in data centers. To address the limitations of existing models in terms of training efficiency and generalization performance, this study proposes a cooling load prediction model that integrates the Light Gradient Boosting Machine (LightGBM) algorithm with Bayesian Optimization. The model was validated using data generated from an EnergyPlus simulation of a representative medium-scale data center. Comparative analysis demonstrates that the proposed model surpasses naive benchmarks (T-1, T-24, T-168) and other machine learning models (SVR, XGBoost, LSTM), achieving superior performance with an Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE) of 4.3234 kW, R2 of 0.9999, and Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE) of 0.07%. The total runtime and Relative Prediction Deviation (RPD) were 33.45s and 86.2685, respectively, indicating an excellent balance between computational efficiency and robust predictive reliability. The key contribution of this research is the effective integration of LightGBM and Bayesian Optimization to provide a highly accurate and efficient tool for data center cooling load prediction. This approach offers a scientific foundation for the intelligent control of cooling systems and energy efficiency optimization in data centers, with direct practical implications for building energy management.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一种结合LightGBM算法与贝叶斯优化的数据中心冷却负荷预测模型，相比传统基准模型和其他机器学习方法，在预测精度和计算效率方面表现更优。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一个能够准确预测数据中心冷却负荷的高效模型，以解决传统模型在处理复杂非线性和多变量耦合效应方面的局限性？
AI.motivation: 随着信息技术的快速发展，数据中心能耗问题日益突出。准确的冷却负荷预测对于优化冷却系统运行、提高能源效率至关重要，但传统模型难以捕捉数据中心的复杂非线性特性和多变量耦合效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本研究基于机器学习理论，特别是集成学习中的梯度提升决策树框架，结合贝叶斯优化理论进行超参数调优。
AI.method: 采用LightGBM算法与贝叶斯优化相结合的方法，使用EnergyPlus模拟生成的中型数据中心数据进行模型验证，并与朴素基准模型（T-1、T-24、T-168）及其他机器学习模型（SVR、XGBoost、LSTM）进行对比分析。
AI.findings: 提出的模型在各项指标上表现优异：RMSE为4.3234 kW，R²为0.9999，MAPE为0.07%，总运行时间为33.45秒，RPD为86.2685，在计算效率和预测可靠性之间取得了良好平衡。
AI.theory_contributions: 有效整合了LightGBM算法与贝叶斯优化方法，为数据中心冷却负荷预测提供了一个高效准确的理论框架，拓展了机器学习在建筑能源管理领域的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为数据中心冷却系统的智能控制和能源效率优化提供了科学依据，可直接应用于建筑能源管理实践，帮助降低数据中心能耗和运营成本。

title: Biodiversity Risk Exposure and Analysts’ Forecasts
affiliations: Macau University of Science and Technology, The University of Western Australia and The University of Western Australia - UWA Business School

detail.title: Biodiversity Risk Exposure and Analysts’ Forecasts
detail.abstract: We document that greater corporate biodiversity risk exposure is associated with significantly lower earnings forecast accuracy and higher forecast dispersion among financial analysts. These effects are more pronounced for firms with higher earnings volatility or more opaque disclosure environments. Further analyses show that analysts’ professional experience, industry specialization, and biodiversity related expertise mitigate these effects. In addition, stronger stakeholder awareness of biodiversity issues attenuates the influence of biodiversity risk on analysts’ forecast accuracy and dispersion. Our findings highlight analysts’ information processing and forecasting behavior as an important channel through which biodiversity risk affects capital markets.

AI.tldr: 企业生物多样性风险暴露越高，财务分析师盈利预测准确性越低、预测分歧度越高，分析师专业经验、行业专长和生物多样性专业知识可缓解此影响
AI.research_question: 企业生物多样性风险如何影响财务分析师的盈利预测准确性和预测分歧度？
AI.motivation: 生物多样性风险日益成为企业面临的重要环境风险，但现有研究较少关注其对资本市场信息环境的影响，特别是对财务分析师预测行为的影响
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息不对称理论、分析师预测行为理论、环境风险与资本市场关系理论
AI.method: 实证研究，使用企业生物多样性风险暴露数据、分析师盈利预测数据，通过回归分析检验关系，并进行异质性分析和机制检验
AI.findings: 1. 企业生物多样性风险暴露与分析师盈利预测准确性负相关，与预测分歧度正相关；2. 盈利波动性高或信息披露环境不透明的企业，这种影响更显著；3. 分析师专业经验、行业专长和生物多样性专业知识可缓解负面影响；4. 利益相关者对生物多样性问题的关注度越高，生物多样性风险对分析师预测的影响越弱
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次系统研究生物多样性风险对分析师预测行为的影响；2. 揭示了生物多样性风险通过影响分析师信息处理行为进而影响资本市场的新机制；3. 拓展了环境风险与资本市场关系的研究边界
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为企业改善生物多样性信息披露提供依据；2. 为分析师提升生物多样性风险评估能力提供指导；3. 为投资者理解生物多样性风险对投资决策的影响提供参考；4. 为监管机构制定生物多样性信息披露政策提供实证支持

title: Transient CFD-based evaluation of partial HVAC operation in a climate-controlled warehouse: A case study on seasonal thermal-humidity performance and energy implications
affiliations: Ludong University, Kunsan National University and Kunsan National University

detail.title: Transient CFD-based evaluation of partial HVAC operation in a climate-controlled warehouse: A case study on seasonal thermal-humidity performance and energy implications
detail.abstract: This case study addresses potential over operation of HVAC capacity in a newly commissioned climate-controlled warehouse used for storing high value semiconductor related materials. The facility was originally operated with six air conditioners, while on site operation suggested that fewer units could meet the temperature and humidity targets with lower electricity use. Transient coupled CFD simulations were conducted to compare the six-unit baseline with four practical two-unit layouts under both summer cooling and winter heating conditions. Indoor performance was evaluated using transient temperature and relative humidity responses on the mid plane together with spatial uniformity metrics across the occupied height. All two-unit layouts maintained the required environmental envelope, but uniformity was sensitive to unit placement and season. A diagonally symmetric two-unit arrangement delivered the most balanced temperature and humidity uniformity across seasons (Case 3 in summer and Case 3′ in winter). Field electricity metering quantified the operational benefit of reduced operation, with measured average daily consumption decreasing from 4567.8 ± 65.0 to 1561.6 ± 91.0 kWh/day when switching from six to two units. Using an industrial tariff of 0.11 USD/kWh, this corresponds to an estimated operating cost reduction from 502.5 to 171.8 USD/day. The findings provide a practical basis for layout informed partial operation to reduce energy use and cost while maintaining indoor environmental control in large volume storage facilities.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过瞬态耦合CFD模拟，发现半导体材料仓库的HVAC系统存在过度运行问题。将6台空调减少到2台（对角线对称布局）仍能满足温湿度要求，同时日耗电量从4567.8±65.0降至1561.6±91.0 kWh/天，运营成本从502.5降至171.8美元/天。
AI.research_question: 在新建的温控仓库中，HVAC系统是否存在过度运行？能否通过减少运行单元数量来降低能耗，同时保持所需的温湿度环境？
AI.motivation: 高价值半导体材料存储设施通常过度配置HVAC系统，导致不必要的能源消耗和运营成本。现场观察表明，较少的空调单元可能就能满足环境要求。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于计算流体动力学（CFD）的室内环境模拟理论，结合瞬态温湿度响应分析和空间均匀性评估方法。
AI.method: 采用瞬态耦合CFD模拟，比较6台空调基准配置与4种实用的2台空调布局方案。在夏季制冷和冬季制热条件下，通过中平面瞬态温湿度响应和占用高度空间均匀性指标评估室内性能。
AI.findings: 所有2台空调布局都能维持所需环境范围，但均匀性对单元位置和季节敏感。对角线对称的2台布局（夏季Case 3，冬季Case 3′）在季节间提供最平衡的温湿度均匀性。实测日耗电量从4567.8±65.0降至1561.6±91.0 kWh/天，运营成本从502.5降至171.8美元/天。

title: Context-Aware Energy Management for Hybrid Electric Cycling Work Vehicles: Task-Conditioned Meta-Policy Synthesis
affiliations: Chongqing Technology and Business University, Chongqing Technology and Business University, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Chongqing Technology and Business University, Chongqing Technology and Business University, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Context-Aware Energy Management for Hybrid Electric Cycling Work Vehicles: Task-Conditioned Meta-Policy Synthesis
detail.abstract: Current learning-based energy management systems often assume stationary dynamics, limiting their real-world adaptability. This disconnect is critical in hybrid electric cycling work vehicles (HECWVs), where operational tasks such as material handling and passenger transit cause frequent, significant shifts in gross vehicle weight, inducing a dynamics drift that compromises control decisions and severely discounts theoretical optimality. To address this foundational challenge, this paper defines the problem class as variable-attribute dynamic systems (VADS) and innovatively formalizes it using a contextual Markov decision process (CMDP). Subsequently, a novel Progressive Policy Columns (PPC) architecture is introduced. Specifically, a residual-based disentanglement mechanism is employed to isolate attribute-specific knowledge, which effectively alleviates the policy interference inherent in monolithic networks. Furthermore, a context-aware gating network is utilized to capture the continuous uncertainty of payload mass, thereby enabling precise meta-policy synthesis without catastrophic forgetting. This synthesis approach not only achieves rapid learning convergence with sparse samples but also demonstrates significant superiority in adaptability to attribute-heterogeneous scenarios. Validated by real-world data, PPC accelerates offline training convergence by 48.1% compared to a transfer learning (TL) baseline. In online tests, PPC achieves near-optimal fuel economy. Crucially, in attribute-heterogeneous scenarios, the framework improves fuel economy by 7.61% over TL and 24.52% over rule-based strategies, reaching within 1.47% of the dynamic programming optimum. Moreover, its adaptation speed is 163.64% faster than TL, establishing PPC as a robust solution for adaptive energy management.

AI.tldr: 本文针对混合动力工程车辆的动态变化问题，提出了一种渐进式策略列（PPC）架构，通过残差解耦机制和上下文感知门控网络，实现了在载荷质量连续变化下的自适应能量管理，显著提升了燃油经济性和学习效率。
AI.research_question: 如何解决混合动力工程车辆在载荷质量频繁变化情况下的自适应能量管理问题？
AI.motivation: 现有学习型能量管理系统通常假设动态特性是静态的，这限制了其在真实世界中的适应性。在混合动力工程车辆中，物料搬运和乘客运输等任务会导致车辆总质量频繁显著变化，引发动态漂移，影响控制决策并严重偏离理论最优性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 将问题定义为可变属性动态系统（VADS），并使用上下文马尔可夫决策过程（CMDP）进行形式化建模。
AI.method: 提出渐进式策略列（PPC）架构：1）使用残差解耦机制分离属性特定知识，减轻策略干扰；2）采用上下文感知门控网络捕获载荷质量的连续不确定性，实现精确元策略合成而不发生灾难性遗忘。
AI.findings: 1）离线训练收敛速度比迁移学习基线快48.1%；2）在线测试中实现接近最优的燃油经济性；3）在属性异质场景中，燃油经济性比迁移学习高7.61%，比基于规则的策略高24.52%，接近动态规划最优值的98.53%；4）适应速度比迁移学习快163.64%。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）定义了可变属性动态系统（VADS）问题类别；2）使用上下文马尔可夫决策过程（CMDP）形式化建模；3）提出了渐进式策略列（PPC）架构，包括残差解耦机制和上下文感知门控网络。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为混合动力工程车辆提供了自适应能量管理解决方案；2）显著提升了燃油经济性；3）实现了快速学习收敛和高效适应能力；4）在真实世界数据验证中表现出优越性能。

title: Investigating the Explanatory Power of Social Milieus in Forestry: Towards a Better Explanation of Forest-Related Attitudes and Behaviours of Forest Owners
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Investigating the Explanatory Power of Social Milieus in Forestry: Towards a Better Explanation of Forest-Related Attitudes and Behaviours of Forest Owners
detail.abstract: This study examines the explanatory power of Sinus Milieus, a model developed in Germany for social milieu based segregation analysis, particularly in understanding the forest-related attitudes and behaviours of private forest owners (PFOs). By analysing 121 dependent variables, the study compares Sinus Milieus with socio-demographic, structural, and network-related variables. The results demonstrate that Sinus Milieus provide a medium (Cramers V 0.15-<0.25) to strong (CV0.25) explanatory value in understanding PFOs' perceptions of forest threats, future forest activities, priorities for future advisory services, and for future forest land use. In particular, Sinus Milieus offer better explanations for PFOs views on future forest activities and areas for professional advice than other variables, such as socio-demographics. Furthermore, the study reveals that Sinus Milieus are better suited to explain PFOs forest-related behaviour, such as past activities and general information uses, than socio-demographic variables. Additionally the findings show that caretaker networks (who PFO turn to, to get advice) and FOA membership are often significant in explaining forest-related attitudes and behaviours. The study also highlights the interrelations between Sinus Milieus and other key variables, showing that social milieus and network factors are crucial for understanding forest management decisions. In conclusion, the findings suggest that incorporating social milieus and network-related variables into forest management research offers valuable insights into PFOs' attitudes and behaviours, which are often overlooked by traditional analyses. This study contributes to the growing recognition of social milieus in empirical social sciences, emphasising their importance in forest policy, PFO research, and communication.

2. 强调了社会阶层因素在环境行为研究中的重要性
3. 推动了社会阶层理论在实证社会科学中的应用

title: A Cooperative UAV-Truck Cyber-Physical System for Risk-Aware ContainerLogistics: A V2X-Enabled Bi-Level Optimization Framework
affiliations: Central South University, Central South University and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: A Cooperative UAV-Truck Cyber-Physical System for Risk-Aware ContainerLogistics: A V2X-Enabled Bi-Level Optimization Framework
detail.abstract: The rapid growth of global urbanization has placed exceptional strain on urban freight logistics, especially for containerized cargo transport. This paper presents a novel vehicle-infrastructure cooperative system that merges unmanned aerial vehicle surveillance with adaptive truck routing for dynamic risk avoidance. We propose a bi-level optimization framework embedded in a digital twin environment, supported by a Vehicle-to-Everything communication architecture where unmanned aerial vehicles act as mobile sensing infrastructure. The upper level optimizes drone surveillance paths to maximize risk detection, while the lower level performs real-time adaptive rerouting of container trucks using shared risk intelligence delivered via low-latency drone-to-vehicle links. Crucially, the model incorporates an explicit communication component that quantifies the effect of network latency on system performance. Validated through comprehensive simulations against four state-of-the-art benchmarks, our cooperative system demonstrates significant improvements: 6.8–24.2% cost reduction, 12.6–42.3% risk reduction, and 2.8–8.1% service improvement, with near-linear scalability. This research introduces a new paradigm for smart city freight, shifting from efficiency-oriented logistics to network-wide risk resilience through integrated aerial-ground vehicle cooperation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种无人机-卡车协同系统，通过数字孪生环境中的双层优化框架，实现动态风险规避的集装箱货运物流。系统整合无人机监控和自适应卡车路径规划，显著降低了成本、风险并提升了服务效率。
AI.research_question: 如何通过无人机与卡车的车辆-基础设施协同系统，在动态环境中实现集装箱货运物流的风险规避和效率提升？
AI.motivation: 全球城市化快速发展对城市货运物流（特别是集装箱运输）造成巨大压力，需要创新的解决方案来应对动态风险并提高系统韧性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 车辆-基础设施协同系统理论、数字孪生技术、双层优化框架、V2X通信架构、风险弹性物流理论
AI.method: 基于数字孪生环境的双层优化框架：上层优化无人机监控路径以最大化风险检测，下层利用低延迟无人机-车辆链路共享的风险情报进行卡车实时自适应重路由。模型明确量化网络延迟对系统性能的影响。
AI.findings: 与四种最先进基准相比，协同系统显著改善：成本降低6.8-24.2%，风险降低12.6-42.3%，服务改善2.8-8.1%，且具有近线性可扩展性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出无人机作为移动感知基础设施的车辆-基础设施协同新范式；2) 建立整合通信延迟量化的双层优化理论框架；3) 推动物流研究从效率导向转向网络级风险韧性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为智慧城市货运提供可实施的无人机-卡车协同系统；2) 通过数字孪生环境实现动态风险规避；3) 为城市集装箱物流提供成本、风险和服务质量的多维度改进方案。

title: Spatiotemporal Evolution of the Co-reduction of Carbon Emissions and Air Pollutants and the Drivers of Carbon Mitigation: Evidence from a City–Sector–Industry Perspective in China
affiliations: Jilin University (JLU) and Tsinghua University

detail.title: Spatiotemporal Evolution of the Co-reduction of Carbon Emissions and Air Pollutants and the Drivers of Carbon Mitigation: Evidence from a City–Sector–Industry Perspective in China
detail.abstract: Existing studies have primarily focused on the co-reduction of carbon dioxide and air pollutants (CDAP) at the provincial level, in key regions, or within single sectors, while systematic analyses at the city scale, across multiple sectors, and at the disaggregated industry level remain limited. Based on all-sector data and data for four major sectors (power generation, industry, transportation, and residential use) at the city scale, together with data for 11 disaggregated industries at the provincial scale, this study applies the co-control effects coordinate system (CCECS) method and the coupling coordination degree (CCD) model to measure the level of co-reduction between carbon dioxide and major air pollutants (SO2, NOx, PM2.5 and CO). By integrating ArcGIS-based spatial analysis, LMDI decomposition, and econometric regression models, this study reveals the spatiotemporal evolution characteristics of co-reduction and the drivers of carbon mitigation. The results show that: (1) during the period 2006–2020, the overall level of co-reduction of CDAP in China increased significantly, with the spatial pattern exhibiting a diffusion trend from eastern to western regions and a gradual narrowing of inter-city disparities in coordination; (2) the CCD of the co-reduction of CDAP in the industrial, power generation, transportation, and residential sectors respectively exhibits inverted U-shaped, N-shaped, Z-shaped, and oscillatory variation patterns; and (3) the energy structure intensity effect and the energy consumption intensity effect are the primary driving factors of carbon mitigation, while the co-reduction effects of CDAP display significant heterogeneity across different sectors and industries.

AI.tldr: 本研究运用CCECS方法和CCD模型，结合空间分析、LMDI分解和计量回归，系统分析了中国城市尺度多行业二氧化碳与空气污染物协同减排的时空演变特征及驱动因素。
AI.research_question: 中国城市尺度多行业二氧化碳与空气污染物协同减排的时空演变特征是什么？其驱动因素有哪些？不同行业和产业间协同减排效应有何差异？
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要关注省级、重点区域或单一行业的协同减排，缺乏城市尺度、多行业、细分产业层面的系统分析，需要更精细化的研究来指导协同减排政策制定。
AI.theoretical_framework: 协同减排效应坐标系（CCECS）方法、耦合协调度（CCD）模型、空间分析理论、LMDI分解方法、计量经济学回归模型。
AI.method: 基于全行业数据和四大行业（电力、工业、交通、居民）城市尺度数据，以及11个细分产业省级数据，运用CCECS和CCD模型测量协同减排水平，结合ArcGIS空间分析、LMDI分解和计量回归模型分析时空演变特征和驱动因素。
AI.findings: 1）2006-2020年中国CDAP协同减排水平显著提升，空间格局呈现从东部向西部扩散趋势，城市间协调差异逐渐缩小；2）工业、电力、交通、居民部门协同减排CCD分别呈现倒U型、N型、Z型和振荡变化模式；3）能源结构强度效应和能源消费强度效应是碳减排主要驱动因素，CDAP协同减排效应在不同行业和产业间存在显著异质性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）构建了城市尺度多行业协同减排的系统分析框架；2）揭示了不同行业协同减排的动态演变规律；3）识别了协同减排效应的空间扩散机制和行业异质性特征。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为制定差异化行业协同减排政策提供实证依据；2）为区域协同减排战略布局提供空间规划参考；3）为优化能源结构和消费强度提供政策着力点。

title: Improving Decision Quality for Energy System Design via Stochastic Goal Programming with Data-Driven MILPs
affiliations: RWTH Aachen University, Institute of Technical Thermodynamics, RWTH Aachen University, Institute of Technical Thermodynamics, RWTH Aachen University, RWTH Aachen University and Institute of Technical Thermodynamics, RWTH Aachen University

detail.title: Improving Decision Quality for Energy System Design via Stochastic Goal Programming with Data-Driven MILPs
detail.abstract: Achieving climate targets requires energy system planners to decide whether to continue operating existing energy system components or invest in low-carbon alternatives. These decisions must balance competing interests, including cost, greenhouse gas emissions, and supply security, under system-specific constraints and uncertain market and policy conditions. While optimization models can support such decisions, many lack automation, adaptability, and integrated consideration of decision-makers’ preferences and risk attitudes, limiting decision quality in practice.This work aims to improve decision quality in energy system design. We present SecMOD 4Decide, a method that combines automated, data-driven component modeling from operational data with stochastic goal programming (SGP) in a two-stage mixed-integer linear program (MILP). The SGP captures multiple objectives, compromise criteria, and risk attitudes directly within the optimization to enable preference- and risk-sensitive design decisions. We evaluate the trade-offs between computational complexity and decision quality, measured with a regret-based metric, across multiple MILP-compatible component model formulations and compare SGP with a sequential multi-objective optimization and multi-criteria decision-making workflow.We apply SecMOD 4Decide to an industrial case study and analyze economic, environmental, and energetic trade-offs under uncertainty in energy prices and CO2 certificate prices. In our case study, switching from risk-neutral to risk-averse design leads to higher capital intensity, stronger electrification, and lower fossil-fuel dependence. Overall, our results show that component model formulation, decision-making workflow, and risk attitude are major drivers of design decisions and substantially affect decision quality in practice.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SecMOD 4Decide方法，结合自动化数据驱动组件建模与随机目标规划，通过两阶段混合整数线性规划支持能源系统设计决策，考虑多目标、风险态度和不确定性，提高决策质量。
AI.research_question: 如何提高能源系统设计决策质量，在考虑多目标、决策者偏好、风险态度和不确定性的情况下，平衡成本、温室气体排放和供应安全等竞争利益？
AI.motivation: 现有优化模型缺乏自动化、适应性和对决策者偏好与风险态度的综合考虑，限制了实际决策质量。能源系统设计需要在不确定的市场和政策条件下平衡多种竞争利益。
AI.theoretical_framework: 随机目标规划(SGP)、两阶段混合整数线性规划(MILP)、多目标优化、多准则决策制定、风险态度理论（风险中性vs风险规避）
AI.method: SecMOD 4Decide方法：结合自动化数据驱动组件建模与随机目标规划，通过两阶段MILP实现。使用基于遗憾的指标评估计算复杂性与决策质量，比较不同组件模型表述和决策工作流程。
AI.findings: 1) 从风险中性转向风险规避设计会导致更高的资本密集度、更强的电气化和更低的化石燃料依赖；2) 组件模型表述、决策工作流程和风险态度是设计决策的主要驱动因素，显著影响实际决策质量。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出将随机目标规划直接集成到优化中，实现偏好和风险敏感的设计决策；2) 开发了结合自动化组件建模与多目标优化的系统方法；3) 建立了计算复杂性与决策质量的权衡评估框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为能源系统规划者提供实用的决策支持工具；2) 通过工业案例研究展示了方法在分析经济、环境和能源权衡方面的应用价值；3) 帮助决策者在不确定性能源价格和CO2证书价格下做出更优设计选择。

title: How Do Executive Network Connections Affect Suppliers’ Voluntary Disclosures and Hiring Strategies? Evidence from Supply Chains
affiliations: University of Southern Indiana, University of Texas at Arlington, The University of Texas at Arlington and Monash University

detail.title: How Do Executive Network Connections Affect Suppliers’ Voluntary Disclosures and Hiring Strategies? Evidence from Supply Chains
detail.abstract: This study examines whether inter-firm executive networks facilitate the transmission of demand-related information to suppliers. Using 9,954 annual sales forecasts from 2,587 supplier firm-years, we show that external network ties between suppliers’ and major customers’ executives improve suppliers’ sales forecast accuracy, suggesting access to new, value-relevant demand information. This effect is stronger when the connected customer executives work in marketing and weaker when customers exhibit greater transparency or when suppliers have greater bargaining power. Consistent with the value of these information flows, suppliers strategically hire executives connected to important customers, particularly when reliant on a major customer or after losing a prior connection. Social ties are most valuable when customers possess private bad demand news. These findings highlight the role of inter-firm executive networks in enhancing suppliers’ forecast accuracy and shaping firms’ executive hiring decisions.

AI.tldr: 供应商与主要客户高管之间的外部网络关系能够提高供应商销售预测准确性，这些社会关系为供应商提供了新的、有价值的需求信息，并影响高管招聘决策。
AI.research_question: 企业间高管网络是否有助于将需求相关信息传递给供应商？
AI.motivation: 理解社会网络在企业间信息传递中的作用，特别是高管网络如何帮助供应商获取客户需求信息以提高预测准确性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会网络理论、信息不对称理论、资源依赖理论、高管网络与信息流动
AI.method: 使用9,954个年度销售预测数据，来自2,587个供应商公司年度的样本，实证分析高管网络关系对销售预测准确性的影响
AI.findings:
1. 供应商与主要客户高管的外部网络关系能显著提高供应商销售预测准确性
2. 当连接的高管在营销部门工作时效果更强
3. 当客户透明度较高或供应商议价能力较强时效果较弱
4. 供应商会战略性地招聘与重要客户有联系的高管，特别是在依赖主要客户或失去先前联系后
5. 当客户拥有负面需求信息时，社会关系最有价值
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 揭示了企业间高管网络在信息传递中的具体作用机制
2. 拓展了社会网络理论在企业间关系中的应用
3. 深化了对信息不对称条件下企业决策的理解
4. 为高管招聘决策提供了新的理论视角
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为企业如何利用高管网络获取需求信息提供实践指导
2. 帮助供应商改进销售预测准确性
3. 为企业高管招聘策略提供决策依据
4. 揭示了在不同情境下网络关系的价值差异
